name: Desktop File Manager with Code Component
summary: Desktop-style file manager CodeComponent with ContextMenu on file items featuring sub-menus for Open With options (Editor, Preview, Terminal), Cut/Copy/Paste with keyboard shortcut hints, Rename, Delete, and Properties. ButtonGroup toolbar switches between grid, list, and details view modes. Toggle buttons control hidden file visibility and sort order. Supports click-to-select and shift-click multi-select. Uses useArrayState for files, useAppState for view state, and toast for file operation feedback.
shortSummary: File manager with ContextMenu sub-menus, ButtonGroup toolbar, and multi-view modes
